needs.proposedSignature: a face declaration `squad?: ManaCost` + a `covers[].by` kind 'squad' with the anchored shape /^squad (\{.+\})$/ (value check: squad.raw equals the printed cost); a cast-time repeatable optional additional cost recorded on the spell (castWith.squadPaid: number, payable any number of times under CR 601.2b/f-h); an Amount { count: 'squad-paid' }; and the linked ETB { on: 'etb', self: true } -> { op: 'token-copy', target: 'self', count: { count: 'squad-paid' } }; plus KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS['squad']
needs.semantics: Squad [cost] is a repeatable optional additional cost plus a linked ETB that creates one token copy of the creature per payment. `additionalCosts` can only state a cost once and no amount can read how many times an optional additional cost was paid, so both halves are unexpressible.
